_note: Detective catalogue. live:false entries are shown but cannot be run; they point to a case file. Parameter names and units from data/POWER_LIVE_NOTES.md.

variables.name: Air temperature
variables.one_line: How warm the air is about 2 meters above the ground, the height of a weather station thermometer.
variables.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES model-based data)

variables.name: Daily high air temperature
variables.one_line: The monthly average of each day's highest air temperature, 2 meters up.
variables.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES model-based data)

variables.name: Daily low air temperature
variables.one_line: The monthly average of each day's lowest air temperature, 2 meters up.
variables.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES model-based data)

variables.name: Rainfall
variables.one_line: Rain plus snow water reaching the ground, averaged per day.
variables.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES model-based data)

variables.name: Sunlight reaching the ground
variables.one_line: Sunlight energy landing on a flat patch of ground, clouds included.
variables.source: NASA POWER (CERES satellite-derived solar and cloud products)

variables.name: Cloud cover
variables.one_line: The share of the sky covered by cloud, on average.
variables.source: NASA POWER (CERES satellite-derived solar and cloud products)

variables.name: Humidity
variables.one_line: How close the air is to being full of water vapor (relative humidity).
variables.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES model-based data)

variables.name: Wind speed
variables.one_line: How fast the air moves, about 10 meters above the ground.
variables.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES model-based data)

variables.name: Soil wetness, root zone
variables.one_line: How wet the soil is in the top meter where plant roots grow, from 0 (dry) to 1 (wet).
variables.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES model-based data)

variables.name: Soil wetness, surface
variables.one_line: How wet the top 5 cm of soil is, from 0 (dry) to 1 (wet).
variables.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES model-based data)

variables.name: Frost days
variables.one_line: The number of days in the month that meet the dataset's frost criterion: the air at 2 m has both its temperature and its dew point below 0 degrees Celsius.
variables.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES model-based data)

variables.name: Snow depth
variables.one_line: How deep the snow lies on the ground.
variables.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 and CERES model-based data)

variables.name: Smoke and haze (aerosol optical depth)
variables.one_line: How strongly smoke, dust and haze block sunlight in the air column. Higher means hazier skies.
variables.not_live_note: Not available live. NASA POWER does not carry it. See it in the case files (Wisconsin, MODIS Aqua).

seasons.name: Wet season, northern tropics (Jun to Sep)
